items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And what about the Christian boys? Do you remember them? All of them. Yeah. All Frank Christian, Charlie Christian, Johnny Christian. [INTERVIEWEE] Emil?

ctx.x: He came from over in the old country.
Yeah, when Frank said, that's what his father, your grandfather, I was just that. All sales for rain. Under the French flag.
